Why Lacrosse Programs Order Factory-Direct

Lacrosse kit has one requirement most suppliers get wrong: the jersey has to fit over pads without looking like a tent, which means the pattern needs shoulder and chest room designed in rather than a size bumped up. The same goes for a goalie jersey, where the padding allowance belongs in the pattern.

Manufacturing direct means those patterns are specified once and reused every season. A single order can carry the game jerseys, the shorts, the reversible practice pinnies and the warm-ups, on one artwork approval - and at twenty sets, a youth club can order as easily as a varsity program. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom lacrosse uniforms?

20 sets per design. Men's and women's cuts of the same design count toward one minimum, and youth through adult sizes mix freely in the same order.

Do your jerseys fit over shoulder pads?

Yes - the men's pattern is drafted with shoulder and chest room for pads rather than relying on a larger size, and goalie jerseys carry a further allowance for chest protection.

How much does a custom lacrosse uniform cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Comparable sublimated jersey baselines on our published pricing page run $18-20 per set at team quantities, falling with volume.

Can you make women's kilts and skorts?

Yes, on properly graded women's patterns with an inner short, in fabric and colourway matched to the jerseys.

How long does a lacrosse order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days - inside a normal spring pre-season.
